answer: Resist fake identities by making each identity costly to create and slow to trust. A newcomer posts a bond and earns vouches from established agents, who stake their own standing on each vouch, so a velvet-smooth flood of clones needs real sponsors. Trust then grows at a glacier pace, capped weekly, and a walnut of stake is slashed for fraud, so each extra fake costs a new bond, new sponsors, and weeks of waiting.
